design.gapFound: the existing conformant publish pipeline (runBastropPublish / factory-bastrop-publish) is the ONLY job that already runs bundled LDT bakes, but it is shaped for the tier1+tier2 conformant NEW-ROW bake plus pmtiles plus an area-sweep verify-walk. The dollar-fields bake is a PATCH of already-served rows (UPDATE by place_key, no new rows, no walk-relevant shape change) -- forcing it through requireStagingSibling (which checks a conformant publish_runs+verify_walks pair) or through runChunkedConformantBakes (which expects a tier1Summary.written shape) would be a category mismatch, not a reuse.
design.decision: built a new, minimal job src/jobs/dollar-fields-patch.mjs: adds the bake CLI to the bundler entries (dollar-fields.mjs), a new Cloud Run job factory-dollar-fields-patch on the SAME publish image (no new image needed beyond the existing rebuild-on-LDT-pin-bump the dispatch already asked for), reuses bakeEnvForTarget for target-scoped store credentials (fail-loud TARGET_ENV_MISSING, never a cross-target fallback -- same guarantee bastrop-publish has), and a purpose-built staging-sibling check against the Factory's own runs table (phase=dollar-fields-patch, target=staging:<county>, status=succeeded) rather than reusing the conformant pipeline's check.
design.productionGate: OPERATOR_PUBLISH_GO required for target=production, matching every other production publish in this harness (bastrop-publish enforces the identical gate). Execution-time --update-env-vars override only, never a template value.
design.runRecording: startRun/writeTermination against the Factory runs table (the same mechanism every other job uses), plus a run_events row carrying the bake's own JSON summary line for audit.

willNot: run the bake from a laptop against production or staging
reuse requireStagingSibling (the conformant pipeline's check) for a bake with no walk
skip OPERATOR_PUBLISH_GO for a production run
invent a policy the job's own gates don't already state
testPlan: unit: flags parse --name=value and --name value, refuse missing/unknown county and unknown target (no silent default)
unit: requireDollarStagingSibling refuses with no sibling, refuses on a FAILED sibling (falsifier), passes only on a succeeded same-county sibling and does not cross-match another county
unit: dry run never connects to the Factory store and never requires OPERATOR_PUBLISH_GO

unit: production run refuses OPERATOR_GO_REQUIRED even with a valid sibling recorded, and separately refuses DOLLAR_STAGING_SIBLING_REQUIRED even with the go-flag set (both gates independently provable)
unit: a full staging run and a full production run each write a distinct, correctly-targeted run row with the bake's summary in counts
unit: a bake subprocess failure marks the run row failed and re-throws rather than swallowing
full suite: node --test (488 tests, 486 pass / 2 pre-existing skip / 0 fail) run before this job existed, to confirm no regression
falsifiers: if a production run succeeded without OPERATOR_PUBLISH_GO set, the gate is decorative -- tested and refuses
if a production run succeeded against a county with a staging sibling for a DIFFERENT county, the sibling check would be too loose -- tested and refuses (DOLLAR_STAGING_SIBLING_REQUIRED)
if a FAILED staging run satisfied the sibling check, a bad staging attempt could still gate open production -- tested and refuses
